code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated creatinine (suggesting renal impairment), high ferritin and CRP (inflammation), and a prolonged INR. There is also mild monocytosis and basophilia. These findings are consistent with acute systemic inflammation, possible infection or sepsis, and impaired renal function. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
